questions.question: Calculate the pie chart angles for walk 14, taxi 11, bus 6, car 7, bicycle 2.
Give two differences between a bar graph and a histogram.
questions.expected_answer: A bar graph shows categories and has gaps between bars; a histogram shows grouped numerical data on a number line and its bars touch.

questions.question: List three things every bar graph needs.
questions.expected_answer: A title, labelled axes with the frequency axis starting at 0 on an even scale, and bars of equal width with equal gaps.
